Rewrite the macOS menu bar in the Rust backend file at /Users/lion/Documents/tikz-drawer/src-tauri/src/lib.rs. 

First read the full file with read_file to see the current setup.

You need to replace the menu setup section in the `.setup(|app| { ... })` closure. The new menu should follow macOS conventions:

**App Menu ("TikZ Drawer"):** (Tauri adds this automatically, so we don't need to build it)
- About (no-op)
- Separator  
- Settings... (emits "menu-settings")
- Separator
- Services
- Separator
- Hide / Hide Others / Show All
- Separator  
- Quit

Actually, the simplest approach: use `SubmenuBuilder::new(app, "TikZ Drawer")` with items. But on macOS, Tauri adds the app menu automatically. So we just need File, Edit, View, Window, Help.

**File menu:**
- New Canvas (CmdOrCtrl+N, emits "menu-new-canvas")
- Separator
- Export PDF... (CmdOrCtrl+Shift+E, emits "menu-export-pdf")
- Export PNG... (emits "menu-export-png")

**Edit menu:**
- Undo (CmdOrCtrl+Z, no-op placeholder)
- Redo (CmdOrCtrl+Shift+Z, no-op placeholder)
- Separator
- Cut (CmdOrCtrl+X, no-op placeholder)
- Copy (CmdOrCtrl+C, no-op placeholder)
- Paste (CmdOrCtrl+V, no-op placeholder)

**View menu:**
- Center on Selection (emits "menu-center-on-selection")
- Reset Canvas View (emits "menu-reset-view")
- Separator
- Toggle Grid (CmdOrCtrl+G, emits "menu-grid-toggle-canvas")
- Toggle Grid in Export (emits "menu-grid-toggle-export")
- Grid Settings... (emits "menu-grid-settings")
- Separator
- Toggle Properties Panel (emits "menu-toggle-properties")
- Toggle TikZ Preview (emits "menu-toggle-tikz")
- Toggle PDF Preview (emits "menu-toggle-pdf")

**Window menu:**
- Minimize
- Zoom
- Separator
- Bring All to Front

**Help menu:**
- TikZ Drawer Help... (no-op placeholder)

Use `tauri::menu::{MenuBuilder, SubmenuBuilder, MenuItemBuilder}`.

IMPORTANT: Keep ALL existing tauri::command functions, plugin initialization, and invoke_handler exactly as they are. Only replace the menu building portion inside `.setup(|app| {`.

The on_menu_event handler must handle these NEW event IDs:
- "menu-settings"
- "menu-toggle-properties"  
- "menu-toggle-tikz"
- "menu-toggle-pdf"

And keep all existing event IDs.

When creating no-op items (Undo, Redo, Cut, Copy, Paste, Help, About), just use `MenuItemBuilder::with_id(...)` and in on_menu_event, match them but do nothing (or just ignore in the match with `_ => {}`).

Write the complete updated file content using write_file.
